subject.title: fix(feishu): retry once on token-invalid errors 99991663/99991664 with cache invalidation (fixes #97287)

question: Should Feishu token-invalid recovery invalidate every account's SDK and CardKit caches as this PR does, or be narrowed to the account whose request returned 99991663 or 99991664?
rationale: Both approaches can recover the reported failure, but only the Feishu owner can confirm whether process-wide eviction is an intentional lifecycle contract or avoidable cross-account churn.

options.title: Scope invalidation per account
options.body: Pass account-specific invalidators through the request boundary so only the failed account is recreated before the one-shot retry.

options.title: Accept global eviction
options.body: Keep the registry design after explicitly confirming that occasional cross-account token refresh is safe and documenting that lifecycle invariant.

options.title: Choose the alternate candidate
options.body: Pause this PR and sponsor another implementation only after it proves normal sends, CardKit behavior, persistent-error preservation, and real recovery.

recommendation.title: Scope invalidation per account
recommendation.body: Pass account-specific invalidators through the request boundary so only the failed account is recreated before the one-shot retry.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu package identifies @m1heng as the community owner, making them the strongest available decision owner for cache lifecycle and canonical implementation selection.
